key_idea: Two passes in rank order: first take teams whose school is under the cap, then fill leftover slots with the best untaken teams.
sketch: Pass 1 walks the ranking and marks a team if its school has fewer than c marked teams, stopping at k. Pass 2 walks the ranking again and marks unmarked teams until k are chosen. Finally print marked teams in rank order (not in selection order). O(n) with a per-school counter array. Pitfall: output must be merged back into rank order, and pass 1 must stop once k teams are taken.
